recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片只看到紅血球變化：散在淚滴狀紅血球（dacrocyte）與少數不規則碎片狀紅血球，血小板數量不少；畫面中並沒有腫瘤細胞，需結合轉移性攝護腺癌侵犯骨髓或慢性 DIC 的臨床背景解讀。
features: Scattered teardrop cells (dacrocytes) among normochromic red cells
Occasional irregular fragmented / helmet-like red cells
No nucleated red cells, immature myeloid cells or tumor cells in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normochromic red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis, including scattered teardrop cells and occasional fragmented, helmet-like forms. Platelets appear adequate. No leukocytes, nucleated red cells or circulating tumor cells are present in this field. These red cell changes are nonspecific; in a patient with metastatic prostatic carcinoma they are suggestive of marrow infiltration (myelophthisis) and/or tumor-associated microangiopathy or chronic DIC, but the carcinoma itself is not demonstrated in this image.

ddx.vs: Also produces dacrocytes, but typically with a leukoerythroblastic picture and a JAK2/CALR/MPL mutation rather than a known carcinoma with marrow metastases.
TMA shows abundant schistocytes with marked thrombocytopenia, whereas here fragments are few and platelets appear adequate.
These show microcytic hypochromic cells and target cells or pencil cells rather than normochromic cells with teardrops and helmet cells.
